proof: The nine dual Hesse lines have precisely 12 triple intersections, checked by grouped and mixed pairs and 36-pair exhaustion. The chosen infinity line avoids them all, so directions are distinct. Setting all affine offsets proportional to t gives reduced fibers with a common transverse sphere and all singularities strictly inside its half-radius ball.

The x-leading coefficient is constant and each component is an ordinary graph. Local torsion-freeness over the parameter DVR proves analytic flatness; nine normal smooth components give the product integral closure, restricting to each normalized fiber. The circle formula certifies transverse disjoint boundary and disk normalizations.

For an ordinary r-fold singularity the δ invariant is r(r−1)/2 and the exact stipulated rough value is r−2. One blowup gives K=E, E²=−1 and EC′=r. This gives constant total δ=36 and rough value increasing from 7 to 12. The Fermat arrangements produce excess n²−4 with the same pair count and uniform construction for every n≥3.
